policy: Publish manifest — deny-by-default. Every tracked file must match allow or deny; deny wins. Public placement requires Owner's case-by-case adjudication on top of this tool passing (AGENTS.md: PUBLIC-REPO GATE).

deny.docs/research/*: internal citation vault — upstream/third-party names live only here
deny.deploy/upstream_shim.env: upstream execution facts — must be DELETED at mycore before any public release
deny.docs/design/*: internal decision archive (contains adjudication records + machine paths)
deny.deploy/*.local: machine-local runtime config (chat id / memory sources)
deny.AGENTS.md: owner decree book: private rulings, repo wiring and the publication gate rules — the public snapshot ships AGENTS.public.md as AGENTS.md instead (desensitization car 2026-10-28)
deny.docs/handover/*: internal handover records: owner rulings, competitive comparisons, machine wiring
deny.tests/runs/*: archived A/B run transcripts: owner dialogue and private persona material
deny.deploy/check_publish.py: gate tooling — embeds the leak signatures by design (self-excluded scanner)
deny.deploy/export_public.py: the only public-repo writer — embeds the leak signatures by design
deny.deploy/pre_release_audit.py: development-only pre-release audit — imports the two tools above and scans the development history
deny.docs/publish_iron_rules.md: specification of the development-side publication gate (the tools it documents are not shipped)
deny.deploy/publish_transform.json: desensitization rule table — states exactly what is being hidden
deny.deploy/githooks/*: push-blocking hooks wired to the private development remote
deny.docs/p5/swap_gap_assessment.md: internal migration-gap assessment: point-in-time engineering notes citing the private AGENTS.md and its line numbers; no value to a product user (ruling 2026-10-29)
